title: P1.9d Remove private benchmark corpus default
description: packages/benchmark/src/pre-freeze-pinned-documents.ts still defaults to D:\projexts\moes, making tests/release behavior depend on one developer machine. Require explicit or repository-portable corpus authority without rewriting historical evidence constants.
definitionOfDone: Re-measure every production/test caller of the pinned-document root and distinguish live defaults from frozen historical provenance values.
No live default or production code path points to D:\projexts\moes. The corpus root is explicit or derived from a repository-portable tracked location.
Missing, unreadable, dirty, moving, or out-of-repository corpus authority refuses with exact stable code and layer; caller-supplied SHA/digests cannot replace observed Git authority.
Benchmark tests execute nonzero on Windows/Linux/macOS-shaped paths without the private directory; mutation restores the private default and makes the portability assertion red.
taskRails: Re-measure current HEAD, exact-path porcelain, and live ownership before planning or editing; adopt provenance-verified foreign WIP or block on collision.
Use production-reachable evidence, exact stable refusal code and layer where applicable, nonzero tests, mutation drills for security boundaries, and explicit-pathspec commits only.
Do not silently rewrite frozen phase-zero evidence or choose a new corpus/custody authority without an existing contract; block and name the required human decision if none exists.

implementationPlan.description: Remove the private default (DoD 2) in packages/benchmark/src/pre-freeze-pinned-documents.ts, 76 lines. Add the remaining checks DoD 3 names — unreadable, dirty, moved, out-of-repository — each returning its own exact code, and ensure a caller-supplied SHA or digest can never substitute for observed Git authority. Add the PORTABLE proof (DoD 4's executable half) as a new packages/benchmark/src/pre-freeze-pinned-documents.test.ts. These arms must run and pass on any machine WITHOUT the private directory — that is what makes this row's coverage portable, and it is why they belong in their own file rather than inside the corpus-dependent suites. Drive the production entry point with the environment variable unset, blank, whitespace-only, pointing at an absent path, pointing outside the repository, and pointing at a dirty corpus, asserting for each the EXACT code from step 2 AND `layer` equal to PRE_FREEZE_AUDIT_LAYER — never merely that a refusal happened. Build the cases from a module-level FROZEN roster with an EXACT nonzero length assertion and member uniqueness, so an emptied sweep cannot pass. Include Windows-shaped and POSIX-shaped path inputs to satisfy DoD 4's cross-platform clause. Add one arm asserting that a caller-supplied SHA does NOT substitute for observed Git authority.

FROZEN SWEEP with a real denominator: CORPUS_REFUSAL_CASES has 8 members over 4 distinct codes, and the arm "sweeps eight distinct corpus conditions over four distinct codes" pins length 8, label-uniqueness 8, code-distinctness 4 and Object.isFrozen. Cases: unset; empty; whitespace-only; a WINDOWS-shaped absent path (D:\projexts\moes-absent-64b603e7); a POSIX-shaped absent path (/var/tmp/moes-absent-64b603e7) — together DoD 4's cross-platform clause, since each shape is a non-resolving path on the other platform; a readable FILE rather than a directory; a directory no repository governs; a repository holding uncommitted content. Each generated arm asserts the EXACT code AND `layer === PRE_FREEZE_AUDIT_LAYER` as a value, on BOTH readPinnedCorpusAuthority() and readPinnedBenchmarkSpec().

CORPUS_ROOT_MOVED is DRIVEN, not disclosed-undriven. A committed temp repo is made clean, then node:fs is wrapped for one arm so that the real readFileSync lands an untracked file mid-read; both authority observations and the before/after comparison are the production ones. This arm is what exposed a real defect in step 3's first cut: the dirty verdict lived inside the observation, so the SECOND look answered CORPUS_ROOT_DIRTY and the moved-tree condition was unreachable — the arm failed `expected 'CORPUS_ROOT_DIRTY' to be 'CORPUS_ROOT_MOVED'`. Fixed by splitting the raw observation (observeCorpusGit, internal) from the clean-enough verdict (observePinnedCorpusAuthority, exported); readPinnedDocument now checks dirty on the FIRST look and compares raw pairs. Without that split CORPUS_ROOT_MOVED would have been a roster member no input could ever produce.

CALLER-SUPPLIED SHA arm asserts the strong form: both public readers have .length === 0, and passing the GENUINE PINNED_BENCHMARK_SPEC_SHA256 through a forged call signature still yields CORPUS_ROOT_UNSET with the root unset and CORPUS_ROOT_DIRTY against a dirty corpus. If the real digest cannot buy a document past a refused authority, no forged one can.

PORTABILITY ARM (the one step 6 drill D1 targets) is stated over the module's exported surface, not over a grep: no exported string may match /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/, "DEFAULT_PINNED_DOCUMENT_ROOT" must not be `in` the module namespace, and with the variable unset both readers must answer CORPUS_ROOT_UNSET.

The human was shown this and accepted it. The trade is deliberate \u2014 today those suites pass ONLY on one developer's machine and silently prove nothing on any other, so a loud, explicit refusal is strictly more honest than a green that depends on `D:\\projexts\\moes` existing.

Their string is identical to the default being removed, so a careless repo-wide search-and-replace would silently rewrite frozen phase-zero evidence \u2014 that is the single most dangerous mistake available here.
